description: A single spiral plotted in bipolar coordinates between two foci, stroked as gradient-colored line segments from an auto-albers palette.
notable: Uses a bipolar (two-focus) coordinate transform via sinh/cosh to warp the spiral, not the usual polar r=theta.

description: Bipolar-coordinate spiral that rotates continuously as sigma is twisted by the playhead; gradient stroke mirrored around its midpoint.
notable: Looping twist derived directly from playhead so the spiral spins seamlessly over one cycle.

description: Rotating bipolar-coordinate spiral with per-point Perlin-noise jitter, giving the gradient line a trembling, hand-drawn wobble.
notable: Noise offset is modulated by sin(playhead) so the jitter breathes in and out across the loop.

description: Bipolar coordinate grid of hyperbolic and circular arcs overlaid with a twisting spiral drawn as tiny plus/cross tick marks.
notable: Draws the underlying bipolar coordinate grid (constant-tau and constant-sigma curves) as faint scaffolding under the spiral.

description: Canvas greedily split into rectangular regions, each folded into three faceted quads shaded in near-black P3 greys on pure black.
notable: Barely-there tonal separations (display-p3 greys 0.05-0.2) so facets read only as subtle folds on black.

description: Quadtree-accelerated flocking where each boid's color is the OKLCH-weighted average of its neighbors, leaving gradient trails and triangle heads.
notable: Neighbor hues averaged as sin/cos vectors to handle wrap-around, so color spreads contagiously through the flock.

description: Classic Reynolds flocking of 128 boids leaving gradient-faded trails with triangular heads, wrapping at the canvas edges.
notable: Brute-force O(n^2) neighbor checks; trails fade out near the end of the loop for a clean export cycle.

description: Reynolds flocking scaled to ~900 boids using a d3-quadtree for neighbor lookups, drawing gradient trails and triangular heads.
notable: Quadtree rebuilt each frame with radius-visit culling to make the large flock tractable at 1920x1080.

description: Quadtree flocking whose trail colors are sampled from a Perlin noise field, then the whole frame is downscaled and Atkinson-dithered.
notable: Palette sorted by OKLCH hue and mapped through a low-frequency noise field, giving zonal color; final pass is atkinson dither.

description: Boids whose headings snap to 45-degree increments and step across a fixed grid, drawing pipe-like right-angled trails with square heads.
notable: Velocity heading snapped to PI/4 and advanced by one grid step so the flock reads as circuit-board pipework.

description: Two layers of colored rectangles whose overlaps are repainted in inverted colors, a boolean intersection over a Robert Swain palette.
notable: Overlap regions filled with rybitten-inverted colors so intersections invert the base swatch beneath them.

description: Horizontal ribbons of Chaikin-smoothed paths animated by a marching line-dash offset that draws and erases each band in turn.
notable: Path length measured via an offscreen SVG path element to drive lineDashOffset, so strokes appear to draw themselves.

description: 25 nested double pendulums of increasing arm length simulated from the equations of motion, tracing chaotic looping trails that fade.
notable: Semi-transparent background fill leaves ghost trails; length-ramped pendulums fan the chaos into a layered rosette.

description: Chladni plate nodal field sampled on a grid and rendered as an ASCII heatmap of glyphs, dark-to-light, in the jgs7 pixel font.
notable: Closed-form Chladni equation quantized to six characters (space to @) so nodal lines emerge as text density.

description: 10k particles random-walk with amplitude driven by a Chladni equation, migrating onto the nodal lines; optional greyscale heatmap.
notable: Stochastic amplitude proportional to the Chladni value pushes particles toward zero-crossings, a physical-sand analogy.

description: Four overlaid Chladni particle systems, each with its own m/n frequencies and palette color, settling into interleaved nodal patterns.
notable: Layering four independent frequency modes builds a moire of competing nodal sets in different colors.

description: Chladni particles migrate a few steps leaving tapered, smoothed brush strokes across four colored systems; optional Atkinson dither.
notable: Trails turned into filled tapered ribbons via polyline-normals with quadratic width easing for calligraphic ends.

description: Chladni particles drawn as short smoothed trail paths across four colored systems, post-processed with Atkinson dithering.
notable: Noise-driven walk (not pure random) plus a downscale-and-dither pass gives the nodal streaks a printed, grainy texture.

description: 2D circle packing via pack-spheres, rendered only as concentric circle outlines centered on the canvas over a dark generated ground.
notable: Split-complementary rampensau palettes and spiral scaffolding are prepared but the render is stuck in debug outline-only mode.

description: A grid of plus-shaped textile motifs that stretch and contract through a looping sequence of x/y scale steps, like breathing weave.
notable: A hand-authored table of x/y stretch keyframes drives the motif's elastic breathing across the loop.

description: Static woven-textile pattern built from four stacked layers of interlocking plus-shaped cells on a stepped grid.
notable: Each palette color is a distinct plus-motif layer with its own horizontal step, reading as a flat-weave swatch.

description: Woven plus-motif pattern animated by slicing the canvas with getImageData and cycling rows upward like a carousel.
notable: Scroll achieved by copying image-data slices and re-pasting them, at a deliberate 2fps for a mechanical loom feel.

description: Layered plus-motif textile pattern colored by a procedurally generated pro-color-harmonies palette in OKLCH.
notable: Same weave motif as clearloop/basic but recolored from random harmony schemes with sine/wave/zap modifiers.

description: Five-layer woven textile pattern scrolling vertically, colored with a Robert Swain field palette and a striped top/bottom border.
notable: The fifth layer indexes a 3x3 nested color grid, and the whole weave scrolls with a wrapped y-offset.
